This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns, you can take the Dash action.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "bonus_action_dash": true}, "display": "Bonus Action to cast & Dash. Can Dash as Bonus Action every turn (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: For the spell's duration, your eyes become an inky void imbued with dread power. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects: Asleep, Panicked, or Sickened.
You convert raw materials into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool.

Each object in a 20-foot Cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast is also outlined in light if it fails a Dexterity saving throw. Attack rolls against outlined creatures or objects have Advantage.
You conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within range, where it remains for the duration, until you dismiss it, or until you move more than 100 feet from it.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon_stationary", "damage": "4d8 Piercing", "vision": "see_invisible"}, "display": "Summon invisible hound. Bites enemies for 4d8 Piercing. Detects invisible."}

spells.spell_desc: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points for the duration.

You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration.
Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "reaction", "target_max": 5}, "display": "Reaction. Slow falls for up to 5 creatures. No fall damage."}

spells.spell_desc: You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range, attempting to shatter its intellect and personality. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make an Intelligence saving throw.
You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon", "is_ritual": true, "cost": "10 gp incense"}, "display": "Ritual. Summon a permanent animal familiar to assist you."}

spells.spell_desc: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon", "target": "mount"}, "display": "10-min cast. Summon a loyal, intelligent mount."}

spells.spell_desc: This spell allows you to find the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific fixed location that you are familiar with on the same plane of existence.
You sense the presence of any trap within range that is within line of sight.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "radius": "120ft"}, "display": "Instantly sense if there are traps within 120 ft line of sight."}

spells.spell_desc: You send negative energy coursing through a creature that you can see within range, causing it searing pain. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A humanoid killed by this spell rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie that is permanently under your command.

You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried. This spell's damage increases by 1d10 when you reach levels 5 (2d10), 11 (3d10), and 17 (4d10).

Thin and wispy flames wreathe your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can choose a warm shield (Fire resistance) or a chill shield (Cold resistance).

A storm of roaring fire appears at a point you choose within range. The storm is made up of ten 10-foot cubes, which you can arrange as you wish. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 7d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.components: V, S, M (a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur)
spells.spell_desc: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners. It ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. At Higher Levels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3rd.
You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. You can use an action to make a melee spell attack. On a hit, 3d6 fire damage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon_weapon", "damage": "3d6 Fire"}, "display": "Bonus Action. Create fiery blade. Use Action to attack for 3d6 Fire damage (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: A vertical column of divine fire roars down from the heavens in a location you specify. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_damage", "area": "cylinder", "radius_ft": 10, "height_ft": 40, "save_stat": "Dexterity", "damage": [{"type": "Fire", "dice": "4d6"}, {"type": "Radiant", "dice": "4d6"}]}, "display": "10-ft Radius Cylinder. Dex Save (Half). 4d6 Fire + 4d6 Radiant. Upcast: +1d6 per slot level."}

spells.spell_desc: A 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within range and lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes 2d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
You attempt to turn a creature that you can see within range into stone. If the target's body is made of flesh, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained.
This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "capacity_lb": 500}, "display": "Ritual. Create a disk that follows you and carries 500 lbs."}

spells.components: V, S, M (a wing feather from any bird)
spells.spell_desc: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall.
You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere is heavily obscured.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_effect", "area": "20ft sphere"}, "display": "20-ft Sphere. Heavily obscured area (Concentration). Upcast: +20ft radius."}

spells.spell_desc: You create a ward against magical travel that protects up to 40,000 square feet of floor space to a height of 30 feet above the floor. For the duration, creatures can't teleport into the area or use portals.

An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison composed of magical force springs into existence around an area you choose within range. The prison can be a cage or a solid box. A creature inside can't leave by nonmagical means.

You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future. For the duration, the target can't be surprised and has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.

You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can't reduce the target's speed or cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.

A globe of frigid energy streaks from your fingertips to a point of your choice within range, where it explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw.
You transform a willing creature you touch, along with everything it's wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for the duration. The target has a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover.

You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence. The portal is a circular opening, which you can make 5 to 20 feet in diameter.
You place a magical command on a creature that you can see within range, forcing it to carry out some service or refrain from some action or course of activity as you decide.
Preserves a corpse so it cannot become Undead and extends time limit for Resurrection.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "duration": "10 days"}, "display": "Ritual. Preserve corpse for 10 days."}

spells.spell_desc: You transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range into giant versions of their natural forms for the duration.

Until the spell ends, when you make a Charisma check, you can replace the number you roll with a 15. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if you are telling the truth indicates that you are being truthful.

An immobile, faintly shimmering barrier erects around you in a 10-foot radius and remains for the duration. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier can't affect creatures or objects within it.
When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures, either upon a surface or within an object that can be closed. Choose Explosive Runes or Spell Glyph.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_trap", "modes": ["Explosive Runes", "Spell Glyph"], "cost": "200 gp"}, "display": "1-hour cast. Create a magical trap (5d8 dmg or store a spell). Cost: 200 gp."}

spells.spell_desc: Up to ten berries appear in your hand. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and provides enough nourishment for one day.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "berry_count": 10, "heal_per_berry": 1}, "display": "Create 10 berries. Each heals 1 HP and counts as 1 day of food."}

spells.spell_desc: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range. Dexterity Save or fall Prone.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_hazard", "save_stat": "Dexterity", "condition": "prone"}, "display": "10-ft Square. Difficult terrain. Dex Save or fall Prone."}

spells.spell_desc: Target becomes invisible. Unlike normal invisibility, this doesn't end when the target attacks or casts.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "condition": "invisible", "persist_on_attack": true}, "display": "Touch. Target is Invisible for 1 min. Does NOT end on attack (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target's exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following: charmed, petrified, ability score reduction, or max HP reduction.

A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity.
You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (such as a stronghold or a labyrinth). The warded area can be up to 20 feet tall, and as shaped by you.

You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check.
A flash of light streaks toward a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, 4d6 Radiant damage, and next attack against it has advantage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "attack", "damage": "4d6 Radiant", "effect": "advantage_next_attack"}, "display": "Ranged Attack. 4d6 Radiant & Adv. on next attack against target."}

spells.spell_desc: A line of strong wind pushes creatures away and makes area difficult terrain.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe", "push": "15ft", "terrain": "difficult"}, "display": "60-ft Line. Push creatures 15 ft (Strength Save)."}

spells.spell_desc: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet. Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead can't enter the area.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_ward", "radius_ft": 60, "cost": "1,000 gp herbs/oils", "blocks_types": ["celestial", "elemental", "fey", "fiend", "undead"]}, "display": "24-hour cast. 60-ft Ward. Blocks specific types. Can tie extra effect (Courage, Silence, etc). Cost: 1,000 gp."}

spells.spell_desc: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube look, sound, and smell like another sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to look like a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain.

You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful one.

spells.components: V, S, M (a shaving of licorice root)
spells.spell_desc: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.
A surge of positive energy washes through a creature you can see within range, regaining 70 hit points. This spell also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target.
A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "heal", "is_bonus_action": true, "heal": "1d4+mod"}, "display": "Bonus Action Heal. 1d4 + Mod. Upcast: +1d4 per level."}

spells.spell_desc: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell.

You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't begin until this hour is over.
A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Immune to frightened and gains Temp HP equal to your spellcasting modifier each turn.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "temp_hp_per_turn": "spellcasting_mod"}, "display": "Touch. Immune to Frightened. Gains Temp HP every turn (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: A creature of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "save", "save_stat": "Wisdom", "condition": "incapacitated_and_prone"}, "display": "Wis Save. Fail: Prone & Incapacitated with laughter (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. This spell has no effect on undead. At Higher Levels: Target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th.

spells.components: V, S, M (a small, straight piece of iron)
spells.spell_desc: Choose a Humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target. At Higher Levels: You can target one additional Humanoid for each spell slot level above 2nd.

Divine light washed out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you. Creatures of your choice in that radius shed dim light in a 5-foot radius and have advantage on all saving throws.
Choose a creature. You deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "bonus_action": true, "damage_bonus": "1d6"}, "display": "Bonus Action. +1d6 damage to target on weapon hit (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration.
A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw.
You choose one object. You learn its magical properties and how to use them.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "cost": "100 gp Pearl"}, "display": "Ritual. Reveal magic properties of an object or creature."}

spells.spell_desc: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that hides its true meaning.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true}, "display": "Ritual. Hide true text behind an illusion. Cost: 10 gp ink."}

spells.spell_desc: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell. While bound, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age.
A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is heavily obscured.
Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "attack", "damage": "3d10 Necrotic"}, "display": "Melee Spell Attack. 3d10 Necrotic damage."}

spells.spell_desc: Swarming, biting insects fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The area is lightly obscured and is difficult terrain.
You touch an object and its name is inscribed on a sapphire. You can later summon the object to your hand.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "cost": "1,000 gp Sapphire"}, "display": "Ritual. Link an object to a sapphire to summon it later."}

spells.components: V, S, M (an eyelash encased in gum arabic)
spells.spell_desc: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.
You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "effect": "triple_jump_distance"}, "display": "Touch. Target's jump distance is tripled for 1 minute."}

spells.spell_desc: You tap an object that is stuck, barred, locked, or held by an arcane lock. If the object has multiple locks, only one of them is unlocked. If you choose a target that is held by arcane lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes.

Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named. The lore might consist of current tales, forgotten stories, or even secret lore that has never been widely known.
You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. An unwilling creature must make a Constitution saving throw.
You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a rod of amber, crystal, or glass)
spells.spell_desc: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. At Higher Levels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 3rd.
Describe a kind of beast or plant. You learn the direction and distance to the closest one within 5 miles.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "radius_mile": 5}, "display": "Ritual. Locate closest beast or plant within 5 miles."}

spells.spell_desc: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you.
Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you.

spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of dirt)
spells.spell_desc: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "speed_bonus": 10}, "display": "Touch. Target gains +10 ft Speed for 1 hour."}

spells.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)
spells.spell_desc: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as a Bonus Action.

A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. You can use your action to control the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a vial. The hand can't attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

You create a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead.

Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container used as the spell's material component. While your soul is in the container, you can attempt to possess humanoids.

You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 Force damage. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several. At Higher Levels: The spell creates one more dart for each spell slot level above 1st.
You implant a message in an object that is delivered when a trigger occurs.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "trigger": "conditional"}, "display": "Ritual. Object speaks a message on a specific trigger."}

spells.spell_desc: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_extradimensional", "duration_hours": 24, "capacity": "100 people"}, "display": "1-min cast. Create a lavish extradimensional mansion for 24 hours."}

spells.spell_desc: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration.

A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each target regains hit points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. This spell also cures all diseases and ends any blindness or deafness.
As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you.

You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes. The target can use its action to attempt to escape by making an Intelligence check (DC 20).
You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "duration_hours": 8}, "display": "Ritual. Merge into stone block. Cannot see, but can hear."}

spells.spell_desc: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken chain link, two halves of a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin.
You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a Dexterity saving throw.
Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition.
You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The illusion includes audible, visual, tactile, and olfactory elements. Unlike minor illusions, the terrain created can be physically interacted with.

Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real.
You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.
Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.
You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. One creature that you can see must make a Wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw.

A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. It takes 2d10 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Choose an area of terrain no larger than 40 feet square within range. You can reshape dirt, sand, or clay in the area in any manner you choose for the duration.
For the duration, you hide a target that you touch from divination magic. The target can be a willing creature or a place or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

spells.components: V, S, M (ashes from a burned leaf of mistletoe)
spells.spell_desc: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and can't be tracked except by magical means.

A passage appears at a point of your choice that you can see on a wooden, plaster, or stone surface (such as a wall, a ceiling, or a floor) within range, and lasts for the duration. You choose the opening's dimensions: up to 5 feet wide, 8 feet high, and 20 feet deep.

You tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within range and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Summon a quasi-real horse with speed of 100 feet.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon", "is_ritual": true, "speed": 100}, "display": "Ritual. Summon a fast (100ft) steed for 1 hour."}

spells.spell_desc: You beseech an otherworldly entity for aid. The entity must be a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend known to you, a deity, or a pantheon. The entity sends a loyal servant to aid you.
With this spell, you attempt to bind a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend to your service.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "save", "save_stat": "Charisma", "cost": "1,000 gp Jewel"}, "display": "1-hour cast. Bind a summoned creature for 24 hours. Cost: 1,000 gp."}

spells.spell_desc: You and up to eight willing creatures who link hands in a circle are transported to a different plane of existence. Alternatively, you can use the spell to banish an unwilling creature to another plane.
This spell channels vitality into plants within a specific area. There are two ways to use it: as an Action to cause plants to overgrow (difficult terrain) or as an 8-hour ritual to enrich the land.

You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 Poison damage. This spell's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach levels 5 (2d12), 11 (3d12), and 17 (4d12).

This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The spell has no effect on a shapechanger or a creature with 0 hit points.
You speak a word of power that grants 120 temporary hit points to up to 6 creatures.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "temp_hp": 120, "target_max": 6}, "display": "60-ft. Grant 120 Temp HP to up to 6 allies."}

spells.spell_desc: A wave of healing energy washes over one creature. Target regains all Hit Points and ends Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned conditions.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "heal_full", "removes": ["Charmed", "Frightened", "Paralyzed", "Poisoned", "Stunned"]}, "display": "Heal target to FULL HP and remove most negative conditions."}

spells.spell_desc: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly. If the target you choose has 100 hit points or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

You speak a word of power that can overwhelm the mind of one creature you can see within range, leaving it dumbfounded. If the target has 150 hit points or fewer, it is stunned. Otherwise, the spell has no effect.

Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Hit Points equal to 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell also provides the creatures with the benefits of a Short Rest.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The healing increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 2.

This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. You create one of the following magical effects within range: a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a candle, clean or soil an object, chill or warm or flavor material, or create a small trinket or illusion.

Eight multi-colored rays of light flash from your hand. Each ray is a different color and has a different power and purpose. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. For each target, roll a d8 to determine which color ray affects it.

A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long and 30 feet high—or a sphere up to 30 feet in diameter centered on you. The wall has seven layers, each with a different color.
You make an area within range magically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. It blocks sound, vision, sensors, and teleportation.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_ward", "area": "100ft cube", "properties": ["blocks_sound", "blocks_vision", "blocks_sensors", "blocks_teleportation"]}, "display": "Ward 100-ft cube against scrying, teleportation, etc."}

spells.spell_desc: A flickering flame appears in your hand. The flame remains there for the duration and harms neither you nor your equipment. The flame sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The spell ends if you dismiss it as an action or if you cast it again. You can also attack with the flame, although doing so ends the spell. When you cast this spell, or as an action on a later turn, you can hurl the flame at a creature within 30 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific condition occurs. The illusion can last for up to 5 minutes.
You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles.
For the duration, the willing creature you touch has resistance to one damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder.

spells.components: V, S, M (holy water or powdered silver and iron)
spells.spell_desc: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. The protection grants Advantage on saving throws against effects created by those creatures, and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target.
You touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. For the duration, the target has advantage on saves against being poisoned, and resistance to poison damage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff_heal", "resistance": "Poison"}, "display": "Touch. Cure 1 poison. Grant Adv on Poison saves & Resistance to Poison damage."}

spells.spell_desc: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true}, "display": "Ritual. Purify food/drink in 5-ft radius."}

spells.components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes)
spells.spell_desc: You return a dead creature you touch to life, provided that it has been dead no longer than 10 days. If the creature's soul is both willing and at liberty to rejoin its body, the creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

A black beam of enervating energy springs from your finger toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends.

A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 Cold damage, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
You shoot a greenish ray at a creature. Ranged spell attack. On a hit, 2d8 Poison damage and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "attack_debuff", "damage": "2d8 Poison", "condition_applied": "poisoned"}, "display": "Ranged Attack. 2d8 Poison damage and target is Poisoned."}

spells.spell_desc: You touch a creature and stimulate its natural healing ability. The target regains 4d8 + 15 hit points. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 1 hit point at the start of each of its turns (10 hit points each minute).
Touch a dead humanoid. If dead < 10 days, provide a new adult body from a random race.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "resurrection", "new_body": "random_race_table"}, "display": "1-hour cast. Bring back dead with a NEW random body. Cost: 1,000 gp Oils."}

spells.spell_desc: At your touch, all curses affecting one creature or object end. If the object is a cursed magic item, its curse remains, but the spell enables its wielder to remove it.

A shimmering sphere of enclosing force encloses a creature or object of Medium size or smaller within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is enclosed for the duration.

You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw.
You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 100 years and that didn't die of old age. If its soul is free and willing, the creature returns to life with all its hit points.

This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects that aren't somehow anchored to the ground in the area fall upward and reach the top of the area.

spells.components: V, S, M (diamonds worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes)
spells.spell_desc: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.
You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end rises into the air, and an invisible extradimensional space opens at the top.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_extradimensional"}, "display": "Create invisible hiding space for up to 8 creatures at the top of a rope."}

spells.spell_desc: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

spells.components: V, S, M (a small silver mirror)
spells.spell_desc: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or a harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or lose the attack or spell.

You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. You can hurl them at one target or several. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 Fire damage. At Higher Levels: One additional ray for each slot level above 2nd.
You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target.
You hide a chest, and all its contents, in the Ethereal Plane. You must touch the chest and the miniature replica that serves as a material component for the spell.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_extradimensional", "cost": "5,000 gp chest + 50 gp replica"}, "display": "Hide a chest in Ethereal Plane. Recall it with replica."}

spells.spell_desc: For the duration, you see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "vision": "see_invisible"}, "display": "Self. See invisible creatures/objects and into Ethereal Plane for 1 hour."}

spells.spell_desc: This spell allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance. An unwilling creature can make a Charisma saving throw.
You send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The creature hears the message in its mind and can answer in a like manner immediately.
By means of this spell, a willing creature or an object is kept safe and concealed. The target becomes invisible and can't be located through divination spells or perceived by scrying sensors.

You assume the form of a different creature for the duration. The new form can be any creature with a challenge rating equal to your level or lower. You retain your Alignment and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.
A sudden loud ringing noise. Con Save. 3d8 Thunder damage. Creatures of inorganic material have disadvantage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_damage", "radius": "10ft", "damage": "3d8 Thunder"}, "display": "10-ft Sphere. 3d8 Thunder (Con Save). Inorganic targets have Disadvantage."}

spells.spell_desc: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

spells.components: V, S, M (a small parchment with a bit of holy text written on it)
spells.spell_desc: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power. For the duration, you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon, and the weapon's damage die becomes a d8. The weapon also becomes magical, if it isn't already.
Next hit deals extra 2d6 Radiant damage. Target sheds Bright Light, attacks against it have Advantage, and it can't be Invisible.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff_on_hit", "bonus_damage": "2d6 Radiant", "effect": "light_and_advantage", "prevents_invisibility": true}, "display": "Bonus Action. Next hit +2d6 Radiant. Target sheds light and grants Adv on attacks against it."}

spells.spell_desc: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature. Make a melee spell attack against the target. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is wearing armor made of metal. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't take reactions until the start of its next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).

For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.
You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "area": "15ft cube"}, "display": "Create a 15-ft cube visual illusion. Can move it as an Action (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: You shape an illusory duplicate of one beast or humanoid that is within range for the entire casting time of the spell. The duplicate is a creature, partially real and formed from ice or snow, and it can take actions and otherwise be affected as a normal creature.
Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect. Targets fall unconscious.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_effect", "hp_pool": "5d8", "condition": "unconscious"}, "display": "20-ft Sphere. Puts creatures to sleep up to 5d8 total HP. Upcast: +2d8 per level."}

spells.spell_desc: Until the spell ends, freezing rain and sleet fall in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder centered on a point within range. The area is heavily obscured, and exposed flames are doused.
You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the spell for the duration.
You cast a burst of sorcerous energy. Choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, Poison, or Psychic. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d8 damage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "attack", "damage_choices": ["Acid", "Cold", "Fire", "Force", "Lightning", "Poison", "Psychic"], "base_dice": "1d8", "exploding_dice": true}, "display": "Ranged Attack. 1d8 damage (Choice). Exploding 8s."}

spells.spell_desc: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.
You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true}, "display": "Ritual. Talk to animals for 10 minutes."}

spells.spell_desc: You grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within range, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and can't be undead.
You imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands.

Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.
Ground in 20ft radius becomes camouflaged spikes. 2d4 Piercing for every 5ft moved.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_hazard", "damage": "2d4 per 5ft", "perception_dc": "spell_save_dc"}, "display": "20-ft Radius. 2d4 Piercing per 5ft moved. Invisible without check."}

spells.spell_desc: You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area.

You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes Force damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.
You launch a mote of light. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, 1d8 Radiant damage and the target emits dim light and cannot become Invisible.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "attack", "damage": "1d8 Radiant", "effect": "prevent_invisibility"}, "display": "Ranged Attack. 1d8 Radiant. Prevents invisibility."}

spells.spell_desc: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured.
You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape that suits your purpose.
This spell turns the flesh of a willing creature you touch as hard as stone. Until the spell ends, the target has resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet. Lightning flashes in the area, thunder cracks, and strong winds roar. Each creature under the cloud when it appears must make a Constitution saving throw.

spells.components: V, M (a snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil)
spells.spell_desc: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within range that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect.
Call forth a Draconic Spirit. It shares your Initiative, obeys commands, and shares one of its Resistances with you.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon", "entity": "Draconic Spirit", "shared_resistance": true}, "display": "Summon a Dragon Spirit to fight for you. You gain one of its Resistances (Concentration)."}

spells.spell_desc: A beam of brilliant light flashes out from your hand in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw.

Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in that light must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 radiant damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph. If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter.

You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell, and as your action each turn for the duration, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range.
Choose up to eight creatures. They can communicate telepathically across any distance.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility", "is_ritual": true, "target_max": 8}, "display": "Ritual. 8 targets. Telepathic link for 1 hour across any distance."}

spells.spell_desc: You create a psychical link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence as you.
This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.
As you cast the spell, you draw a 10-foot-diameter circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know.

You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range. You create one of the following magical effects within range: your voice booms, flames flicker, harmless tremors in the ground, a sound originates from a point, or an unlocked door/window flies open or slams shut.

A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. In addition, unsecured objects that are completely within the area of effect are automatically pushed 10 feet away from you by the spell's effect, and the spell emits a thunderous boom audible out to 300 feet. At Higher Levels: The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1st.
You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No time passes for other creatures, while you take 1d4 + 1 turns in a row, during which you can use actions and move as normal.
A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "utility_ward", "is_ritual": true, "radius_ft": 10}, "display": "Ritual. Create a 10-ft dome. Blocks creatures, objects, and spells."}

spells.spell_desc: This spell grants the creature you touch the ability to understand and speak the language of any intelligent creature that it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language can understand what it says.
This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. The plants must be of the same kind.
You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree.

Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. You transform the creature into a different creature, the creature into an object, or the object into a creature. If you concentrate for the full duration, the transformation becomes permanent.

spells.components: V, S, M (a sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000 GP, which the spell consumes)
spells.spell_desc: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. If the creature's soul is free and willing, the creature returns to life with all its hit points.
This spell gives a willing creature you touch the ability to see things as they actually are. For the duration, the creature has truesight out to a range of 120 feet.

spells.components: S, M (a weapon with which you have proficiency)
spells.spell_desc: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range. Your magic grants you a brief insight into the target's defenses. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this spell hasn't ended.
A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick. The wall lasts for the duration.
An invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "summon", "is_ritual": true, "str": 2}, "display": "Ritual. Invisible servant performs tasks for 1 hour."}

spells.spell_desc: The touch of your shadow-wreathed hand can siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d4 Psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. This spell's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach levels 5 (2d4), 11 (3d4), and 17 (4d4).
A ball of acid explodes. 10d4 acid damage now, and 5d4 acid damage at end of its next turn.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_damage", "initial": "10d4", "dot": "5d4"}, "display": "20-ft Sphere. 10d4 Acid now + 5d4 later (Dex Save Half)."}

spells.components: V, S, M (a small piece of phosphorus)
spells.spell_desc: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick.

spells.components: V, S, M (a pinch of powder made from a clear gemstone)
spells.spell_desc: An invisible wall of magical force appears at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle.

You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a sphere with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels.

A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. If you maintain concentration for the full duration, the wall becomes permanent.
You create a wall of tough, pliable, tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "aoe_damage_hazard", "requires_concentration": true, "shapes": ["60x10x5 ft wall", "20-ft radius circle"], "save_stat": "Dexterity", "initial_damage": "7d8 Piercing", "movement_cost": "4ft_per_1ft"}, "display": "Thorn Wall. Dex Save (Half) for 7d8 Piercing. Moving through costs 4x movement and deals 7d8 Slashing. (Concentration)"}

spells.spell_desc: While near target, they have +1 AC/Saves and Resistance to all damage. You take same damage.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "buff", "ac_bonus": 1, "save_bonus": 1, "shared_damage": true}, "display": "Touch. Target gains +1 AC/Saves & Resistance. You take same damage."}

spells.spell_desc: This spell grants up to ten willing creatures you can see within range the ability to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

This spell grants the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground (creatures, however, still take damage from a hazardous liquid).

spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)
spells.spell_desc: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for the duration. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area.

Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range must make a Wisdom saving throw.
You and up to ten willing creatures you can see within range assume a gaseous form, appearing as wisps of cloud for the duration. While in this form, a creature has a flying speed of 300 feet.
Create a wall of wind that deals 3d8 Bludgeoning and deflects arrows/gases.
spells.mechanics: {"logic": {"action_type": "hazard", "damage": "3d8", "blocks_projectiles": true}, "display": "Wall of Wind. 3d8 Bludgeoning (Str Save). Blocks arrows and gas."}

spells.spell_desc: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires. The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of 8th level or lower.

Word of recall teleports you and up to five willing creatures who are within 5 feet of you to a sanctuary. You must designate a sanctuary by casting this spell within a location, such as a temple, dedicated to or strongly aligned with your deity.

You create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range. Until the spell ends, a creature that enters the spell's area or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius.

feats.feat_desc: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20. Repeatable. You can take this feat more than once.

You gain the following benefits. Initiative Proficiency. When you roll Initiative, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. Initiative Swap. Immediately after you roll Initiative, you can swap your Initiative with the Initiative of one willing ally in the same combat. You can't make this swap if you or the ally has the Incapacitated condition.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with Ranged weapons.

You gain the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Peerless Aim. When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

You gain the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Blink Steps. Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

You gain the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30. Improve Fate. When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

You gain the following benefits. Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 30. Overcome Defenses.
